item.title: Miss Door County to be crowned Feb. 7
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- You are about a week away from learning who the next Miss Door County, Miss Door County Teen and Miss Cherryland will be at the Southern Door Auditorium.

item.title: Fish Tales continue on at Crossroads
item.description: By Coggin Heeringa, Crossroads at Big Creek -- Walleyes are the topic for our next Fish Tales Lecture, scheduled for Thursday, February 12 at 7:00 pm.

item.title: Algoma Public Library Announces Full Slate of February Programs
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Algoma Public Library is offering a wide variety of programs for all ages throughout February 2026, encouraging community members to learn, create and connect.

item.title: Firefighters cooled off by cold temperatures
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Fighting fires is hard enough on its own, but it can be an extra challenge when you throw Mother Nature into the mix.

item.title: NWTC Reflects Growing Public Confidence in Technical College Education
item.description: Adam Collins -- Public confidence in Wisconsin's technical colleges continues to climb, according to new survey results released by the Wisconsin Technical College System.

item.title: Brussels home damaged in early morning fire
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- An early Monday morning fire in the Town of Brussels is serving as a reminder for residents to properly dispose of ashes from wood-burning stoves.

item.title: Coast Guard closes portion of bay to commercial traffic
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- You will have at least one less thing to worry about if you plan on heading onto the ice of the Bay of Green Bay for fishing or other recreational activities.

item.title: Algoma continues its investment in housing
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- When the Algoma Common Council meets February 17th, you could see another step forward in addressing the city's housing needs.

item.title: City collects more than $700,000 in grants for waterfront project
item.description: By Tim Kowols --A reimagined waterfront space near Nautical Drive aimed at improving the boat launch, strengthening the dock wall, and enhancing access and safety is getting closer to becoming a reality, thanks to a pair of grants awarded to the City of Sturgeon Bay.
